title: The Emerald Inheritance
description: A family story of ambition, secrets, style, and inheritance.

blocks.text: The morning at Emerald High began with a silence that felt far too deliberate.
Somewhere beyond the main hall, a door closed. Every conversation stopped.

blocks.speaker: LEXIS
blocks.text: If everyone is going to stare, the least they can do is tell me why.

blocks.heading: An unexpected arrival
blocks.text: A message appeared on the school's announcement screen. The name at the top changed everything.
Across the city, another part of the inheritance was already in motion.

options.label: Investigate the announcement
options.result: Lexis heads towards the administration wing.

options.label: Confront her friends
options.result: Lexis demands to know what everyone is hiding.
